data.one_liner: Pure-Dart post-quantum cryptography for ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA, and HPKE.
data.what_it_does: Provides post-quantum encryption, decryption, digital signatures, and key encapsulation mechanisms (ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA, and RFC 9180 HPKE) for Dart and Flutter. Includes streaming file support and a command-line interface.
use_when: You need post-quantum cryptography resistance (ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA) in Dart or Flutter
You want application recipes like encrypted file vaults, signed media, and hybrid sessions
avoid_when: You only need standard classical cryptography without post-quantum algorithms and prefer simpler native libraries
You need a backend client or state management solution
strengths: Pure-Dart implementation making it web-safe and cross-platform without strict FFI dependencies
Comprehensive suite of NIST post-quantum standards (FIPS 203, 204, 205) and RFC 9180 HPKE
weaknesses: Niche domain-specific cryptographic library requiring specialized security knowledge
Post-quantum cryptographic keys and ciphertexts are significantly larger than classical ones
